name: pod-design-system-test
description: Small design system test environment for POD — sprint-style scope.

scripts.build: pnpm -F pod-test-tokens build && pnpm -F pod-test-ui build && pnpm -F docs build
scripts.build:debug: pnpm -F pod-test-tokens build && pnpm -F pod-test-ui build && echo '=== ui dist ===' && ls packages/ui/dist | head && echo '=== docs node_modules pod ===' && ls -la apps/docs/node_modules | grep pod && pnpm -F docs build
